purpose: Zero-cost local/offline Entity pronunciation source expansion and bounded G2P benchmark preparation

kaikki_proper_names.production_policy: US-tagged parseable IPA may become en-US Entity evidence; unqualified/other-profiled IPA remains provenance-bearing evidence and is not silently relabeled en-US

moby_pronunciator.name: Moby Pronunciator II
moby_pronunciator.runtime_policy: raw evidence only until its ASCII phone mapping is separately validated against accepted English controls
notes: The Moby documentation states that the documentation, software and database are Public Domain material by grant from the author, January 2001.
Do not treat the Project Gutenberg wrapper/trademark terms as the pronunciation database license.
The source is optional because the existing Kaikki and CMUdict artifacts must be exhausted first.

mfa_english_us.runtime_policy: build-time benchmark candidate only until proper-name controls pass; generated provenance mandatory

deep_phonemizer_en_us.production_policy: benchmark adapter allowed; pin and audit the exact pretrained checkpoint license before any production promotion

charsiu_multilingual.reason: upstream README explicitly says some collected pronunciation datasets have unspecified licenses; exact model/data provenance must be audited before production use

hard_rules: no network dependency in product runtime
reuse existing Kaikki and CMUdict artifacts before any new acquisition
no mass G2P before source expansion coverage is measured
generated pronunciation is evidence, never lexical truth
generic English IPA is not silently relabeled en-US
Charsiu remains research-only until model/data licensing is cleanly pinned
